          20000

SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.poi_name) p.poi_name
FROM pois p
WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_Intersects(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_Buffer(
          ST_MakePoint(
            ST_X(ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1)::geography)),
            ST_Y(ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1)::geography))
          ),
          90000 * COS(RADIANS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(
            ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1)::geography),
            ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1)::geography)
          )) - 180))
        )::geography

ORDER BY p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1)::geography) ASC;

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ON (pois.poi_name)
    pois.poi_name,
    pois.wikidata,
    pois.wikipedia,
    ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, target.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%City Suites Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%'
    LIMIT 1
) AS target
WHERE ST_Azimuth(target.geometry, pois.geometry) BETWEEN RADIANS(292.5) AND RADIANS(337.5)
  AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, target.geometry::geography, 60000)
  AND pois.tourism = 'viewpoint'
ORDER BY pois.poi_name, distance_meters ASC;
```
